summary.headline: Masculine and Feminine Signs
summary.text: Completion of the autumnal and winter seasonal triads through Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, associated respectively with earth and water. Section 1 classifies masculine and feminine zodiac signs and places, beginning a list of masculine stars with the Sun, Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars.
